# Pre

::: {.callout-note}
The `uv` python interpreter lives in `~/minstallation/.venvs/KKIK_parse/bin/python`
:::

```{python}
import scanpy as sc
import pandas as pd
import os
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt
import session_info
import glasbey
import yaml
import plotnine as gg
```

Figure settings:

```{python}
plt.rcParams["font.sans-serif"] = "Nimbus sans"
```

Random settings / parameters:

```{python}
step = "4_annotation"
random_state = 275
markers_file = "4_annotation/helpers/markers.csv"
with open(f"{step}/config/annotation.yml") as fh:
    annotation = yaml.safe_load(fh)
res = annotation["resolution"]
```

Create folders for outputs:

```{python}
resdir = "4_annotation/outputs/files"
os.makedirs(resdir, exist_ok=True)
```

Read object from previous step:

```{python}
adata = sc.read_h5ad("3_clustering/outputs/files/sc.h5ad")
```

# Plot DE markers for resolution 1

```{python}
sc.pl.rank_genes_groups(adata,key=f"markers_{res}")
```

# Plot general markers


```{python}
markers = pd.read_csv(markers_file)
genes_in = [marker for marker in markers["gene"] if marker in adata.var_names]
markers = markers.iloc[markers["gene"].isin(genes_in)]
```


```{python}
#| output: asis
print("::: {.panel-tabset}\n")
for cs, genes in markers.groupby("cell_state", sort=False)["gene"]:
    print(f"\n## {cs}\n")
    sc.pl.embedding(
        adata,
        "umap_harmony",
        color=[*genes.tolist(), f"leiden_{res}"],
        ncols=4,
        cmap="magma",
    )
print("\n:::\n")
```

# QC metrics at resolution `{python} res`

```{python}
sc.pl.violin(
    adata,
    keys=[
        "total_counts",
        "log1p_total_counts",
        "n_genes_by_counts",
        "log1p_n_genes_by_counts",
        "pct_counts_mt",
    ],
    groupby=f"leiden_{res}",
    stripplot=False,
    dodge=False,
)
```

# Sample composition by cluster


```{python}
ct = (
    pd.crosstab(
        adata.obs[f"leiden_{res}"],
        adata.obs["sample"],
        normalize="index",
    )
    .reset_index()
    .melt(id_vars="leiden_1.0")
)

(
    gg.ggplot(ct, gg.aes(x=f"leiden_{res}", y="value", fill="sample"))
    + gg.geom_col(position="fill")
    + gg.scale_fill_cmap_d("Set2")
    + gg.theme_bw()
)
```

# Clusters 0, 1 and 2

Clusters 0 to 2 show low quality and high percentage of mitochondrial reads, with a slight stromal signature (eg., expression of *RGS5*, *COL1A1*, *DCN*...). These cells are labeles as *"Stromal"* and will be further analyzed. 

# Assign compartment

`cell_type_1` will be the compartment assigned (immune / epithelial / stromal). These will be further subclustered. The dictionary of clusters at resolution `{python} res` to compartment is saved in `4_annotation/config/annotation.yml`.

```{python}
adata.obs["cell_type_1"] = adata.obs[f"leiden_{res}"].map(annotation["clusters"])
```

Cluster to compartment equivalence:

```{python}
pd.DataFrame.from_dict(annotation["clusters"],orient="index").sort_index(key=lambda i: i.astype(int))
```

## Plot in UMAP


```{python}
sc.pl.embedding(adata, basis="umap_harmony",color="cell_type_1")
```

# Save objects


```{python}
sc.write(adata=adata, filename=f"{resdir}/sc.h5ad", ext="h5ad")

compartments = [
    compartment
    for compartment in adata.obs["cell_type_1"].cat.categories.tolist()
    if compartment != "Low_quality"
]

for compartment in compartments:
    sc.write(
        adata=adata[adata.obs["cell_type_1"] == compartment].copy(),
        filename=f"{resdir}/{compartment}.h5ad",
        ext="h5ad",
    )
```
